provenance.notes: Seed shipped with engram, drawn from a probe pass against claude 2.1.222 and re-checked against that version's help on 2026-08-05: every flag claimed here exists, and --permission-mode accepts acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, manual, dontAsk, and plan. There is deliberately no `default` among them, so the default authority role maps to the empty string and omits the flag rather than passing an invalid value. KNOWN IMPRECISION: read-only maps to `plan`, which is the only mode that structurally will not edit, but plan mode also shapes behavior -- the child plans and presents a plan rather than simply working without write access. That suits a reviewer and may surprise an analyze-and-report task. The more precise spelling is probably a non-prompting mode plus a --disallowedTools list naming Edit, Write, and NotebookEdit, which this spec cannot express today because an authority fragment contributes one argv group for every role rather than per-role argv. Revisit if the difference bites. Flag spellings were read from help, not probed, so nothing here is verified on THIS machine until you run `engram dispatch probe claude --model <M>`. Note that -p means print here and profile on codex, so a spec copied between providers is wrong in a way that runs.
